defs.def: to go around a particular area to make sure that nobody is breaking the law there 警察、军队等

ex.s: With his heart in his mouth, Kevin grabbed Mrs Hill’s home phone and called the police.
ex.t: 凯文紧张得心都提到了嗓子眼，他抓起希尔太太家的电话报了警。

ex.s: Thinking that the man might get away with whatever he wanted before the police arrived, Kevin decided to do something.
ex.t: 想到那个人可能会在警察到达之前逃脱并得到他想要的任何东西，凯文决定采取行动。

ex.s: Kevin followed out and told the arriving police officers what had happened.
ex.t: 凯文跟了出去，向到达的警官们讲述了发生的事情。

ex.s: Paragraph 2:  Kevin and Mr Green took the watch they had found to the police station.
ex.t: 第2段：凯文和格林先生把他们捡到的手表交到了警察局。

ex.s: An idea from lawmakers in New York is to give police officers a new device called the Textalyzer.
ex.t: 纽约立法者提出一个想法，给警察一种名为Textalyzer的新设备。

ex.s: What can the Textalyzer help a police officer find out?
ex.t: Textalyzer能帮助警察查明什么？

ex.s: In Samarkand, Mr Bissell admires the architectural wonders, while on his way to Bukhara he gets a taste of police methods when suspected of drug dealing.
ex.t: 在撒马尔罕，比塞尔先生欣赏建筑奇观，而在前往布哈拉途中，他因涉嫌毒品交易尝到了警察手段的滋味。

ex.s: If your card has been reported to the Police as stolen, please also call into the SAC to request a replacement, bringing with you a copy of your Police Crime Report paperwork.
ex.t: 如果你的卡已被报警称被盗，请也到SAC申请补发，并带上一份警方报案文件的复印件。

ex.s: call the police station in advance

ex.s: The local police chief teams up with a marine biologist and an old shark hunter to hunt it down.
ex.t: 当地警察局长与一名海洋生物学家和一名老鲨鱼猎人合作追捕它。

ex.s: These adventures, often involving the police, are usually the funniest scenes.

ex.s: No matter how many crimes he committed, the police were powerless to arrest him.

ex.s: The lantern fair attracts a lot of people, so it’s one of the busiest times of year for the traffic police.
ex.t: 灯会吸引了大量人流，因此这是一年中交警最忙碌的时期之一。

ex.s: We do our best to help the traffic police keep everyone safe.
ex.t: 我们尽最大努力帮助交警保障每个人的安全。
